run_inference: run inference on a single benchmark system and return predictions with optional performance metrics
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy force and stress error metrics
format_report_table: format benchmark results dictionary as a human-readable table string with energy force and performance columns
PerfCheckRunner: run a benchmark comparing an inference configuration against an fp64 baseline on default test systems
InferenceResult: create an InferenceResult dataclass to store energy forces stress and optional performance metrics from inference
